tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: Current plans and prices in USD: plan, interval, amount_usd, currency, what_you_get. No account needed.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Checkout URL for a plan. With no arguments: the main paid plan. Where the site supports it the URL is a Stripe-hosted Checkout session (created unpaid; a human pays, nothing is charged by this tool). A free plan is only returned when the plan is requested or the company sells nothing else.
